meta.name: prioritization-advisor
meta.description: Choose a prioritization framework based on stage, team context, and stakeholder needs. Use when deciding between RICE, ICE, value/effort, or another scoring approach.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 根据阶段和场景选择最合适的优先级评分框架
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在多个方案中决定先做什么
copy.tagline_en: Choose the best prioritization framework for your stage and context
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to decide what to work on next

howto.what: 它会问你几个关于产品阶段、团队情况、决策需求和数据多少的问题，然后推荐一个最适合你的优先级排序框架（比如RICE、ICE、价值/努力矩阵等），并给出具体的使用步骤。
howto.when: 当你需要决定用哪个优先级排序框架（如RICE、ICE、价值/努力矩阵等）时触发。例如，你正在规划路线图或团队对优先级有争议时。

say.text: 帮我选一个优先级框架：种子期B2B创业公司，40项待办，零使用数据。
say.note: 它会根据你提供的信息开始提问并推荐框架。

say.text: 我们团队总在优先级上争论，推荐一个框架吧。
say.note: 它会引导你完成4个问题，然后给出建议。

howto.what_en: It asks you a few questions about product stage, team context, decision needs, and data availability, then recommends the best prioritization framework (e.g., RICE, ICE, value/effort matrix) with step-by-step implementation guidance.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to choose a prioritization framework (e.g., RICE, ICE, value/effort). For example, during roadmap planning or when stakeholders disagree on priorities.

say_en.text: Help me pick a framework: seed-stage B2B startup, 40-item backlog, zero usage data.
say_en.note: It will start asking questions based on your input and recommend a framework.

say_en.text: We keep arguing about prioritization. Recommend a framework.
say_en.note: It will guide you through 4 questions and then give a recommendation.
